service.description: The in-parameters the Maintenance context services share; each service declares what it returns.

Check that the user may open Maintenance and resolve their scope and the app's routes: capabilities (the maintenance permissions, the derived reads and the areas), the organizations of their maintenance scope (none for a user who reads nothing of Maintenance; every internal organization for a system administrator or a holder of MAINTENANCE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS, allOrganizations) as options, the active one, the user's party and the links. Refuses a user without Maintenance (MAINTENANCE_UNAVAILABLE), a requester, a Projects client contact and a PASS public account among them, and another app root (MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT).

service.description: The options of a Maintenance drop-down the user may choose, searched by term in the query ignoring case, with the selected value's label (Maintenance.js choiceSources): organizations (those of the user's maintenance scope) and facilities (those the organizations own, or organizationPartyId's, for an equipment or facility reader). Later phases add theirs. Refuses a user without Maintenance and an unknown choice.
